label: Dragon Ball Super Card Game / Fusion World
size_source: Official factory mm not found this turn. TAG classifies accepted Dragon Ball TCG as poker-size 2.5 x 3.5 in (https://help.taggrading.com/en/articles/13356059-what-tcg-trading-card-games-can-be-graded-with-tag). ALL_CARDS_SPEC already treats DBS Fusion World as standard TCG sleeves (~63×88). Super Dragon Ball Heroes / Carddass are a different, narrower 'bridge' size and must not use this profile. Confirm factory mm with calipers.
back_cues: uniform DBS / Fusion World back (line-specific; confirm from a sample)
counterfeit_tells: Heroes/Carddass size used on this guide
grader_notes: BGS Europe lists Dragon Ball. ARS lists DRAGON BALL SUPER CARD GAME plus many Heroes/Carddass/Divers lines (those Heroes/Carddass lines are NOT this size). TAG: English, plus 'select Dragon Ball TCG' and Japanese-language exceptions that meet TAG sizing; Heroes/Carddass/bridge size is not eligible at TAG.
